title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the preceding pages, section on 'déploiements' of normal-crossings divisors): X = D_0 is a complex-analytic space or multiplicity (orbifold/stack). Θ ⊂ X is a divisor with normal crossings. D_d is the normalisation of the locus of d-fold crossings, and D_{d_0,...,d_r} for a flag d_0 > ... > d_r ≥ 0 is the corresponding 'flag' multiplicity. These assemble into a semi-simplicial system of analytic multiplicities D_{Δ_r} = ∐ D_{d_0...d_r}. On p.153 Grothendieck shows two things. First, a Θ-admissible part Σ ⊂ X is the same as a compatible choice of unions of connected components D^Σ_d, i.e. of subsets π_0(D_d)^Σ ⊂ π_0(D_d). Second, pulling back gives a sub-semi-simplicial system D^Σ_{Δ_r}.

This page continues the parenthesis. The semi-simplicial system D_{Δ_•} corresponds to the 'analytic category' (an ∞-, in practice 2-, category of strata and specialisations) considered at the start of the notes. D^Σ is a full 'strict' sub-2-category of it. 'Strict' means: if y is in it, so is every object mapping into y. So it is a sieve (crible), 'in a vague terminology', and giving it is equivalent to giving Σ.

He then states the 'Théorème de recollement (2nd version)'. For each flag, V^{Σ*}_{D_{d_0..d_r}} denotes the deleted tubular neighbourhood ('couronne') attached to that stratum-flag. In modern terms this is the torus/punctured-polydisc bundle over the stratum, i.e. the corresponding piece of the boundary of the real oriented blow-up / Kato–Nakayama space. The coproducts V^{Σ*}_{Δ_r} form a semi-simplicial system of topoi (topoi of analytic multiplicities, 'of groupoids'). Its 2-colimit (lim→) is canonically equivalent to V^*_{Σ,X}, the punctured tubular neighbourhood of Σ in X (neighbourhood minus Θ).

This is a descent / homotopy-colimit (van Kampen-type) decomposition of the 'neighbourhood at infinity' of Σ along the stratification. In the M_{g,ν} programme it serves to break the fundamental groupoid at infinity of moduli of curves (Deligne–Mumford boundary) into pieces indexed by boundary strata. The next page specialises it to a curve with Θ a finite set of points, getting π_1(X) as an amalgam of π_1(X*) with punctured-disc groups over a discrete groupoid.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The colimit claim is correct in the homotopy/2-categorical sense: the punctured neighbourhood is (homotopy) equivalent to the gluing of torus bundles over closed strata along flags. However, lim→ must be understood as a 2-colimit (descent) of topoi, not a 1-categorical colimit, and equivalence holds up to shrinking neighbourhoods (pro-object / germ). This is left implicit.

'Strict' is described as 'objects mapping into y': whether this makes a sieve or a cosieve depends on the direction convention for D_{d,d'} → D_{d'}. Grothendieck himself flags the terminology as vague.

ideas.what: Θ-admissible subsets Σ as sieves in the 2-category ('analytic category') of strata of a normal crossings divisor
ideas.modern_name: Closed unions of strata as (co)sieves / downward-closed sets in the exit-path or stratification category
ideas.where_published: Possibly hinted at in Esquisse d'un programme (strata of M_{g,n} and 'tour de Teichmüller'); not explicitly

ideas.what: Punctured tubular neighbourhood of a normal-crossings locus as the 2-colimit of a semi-simplicial system of topoi of 'couronnes' indexed by flags of strata ('Théorème de recollement', 2nd version)
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy-colimit / descent decomposition of the link of an NCD; boundary of real oriented blow-up / Kato–Nakayama space; van Kampen for topoi and stacks
ideas.usually_credited_to: Clemens (1969) topologically; Grothendieck–Murre (LNM 208, 1971) for tame π_1 of formal neighbourhoods of NCD; Kato–Nakayama (1999); van Kampen for topoi (Bunge, Moerdijk); Lurie (∞-categorical Seifert–van Kampen)
ideas.where_published: Related in spirit to SGA1 Exp. IX (van Kampen-type descent) and Grothendieck–Murre LNM 208; the topos-colimit form over the flag system is not known to me in published form

missed.claim: An explicit stack/topos-theoretic gluing theorem: the 'neighbourhood at infinity' of a closed union of strata of an NCD in an analytic multiplicity is the 2-colimit of a semi-simplicial system of torus-bundle topoi over flags of strata. It is designed for the structure at infinity of M_{g,ν} (fundamental groupoid at infinity of moduli of curves). Comparable statements exist piecemeal in the literature (Grothendieck–Murre, Kato–Nakayama, boundary complexes, Boggi's work on profinite Teichmüller groups), but this unified orbifold/topos formulation is an unpublished detail of Grothendieck's programme.
missed.quote: Th. de recollement (2ème version) Les ∐ V^{Σ*}_{D_{d_0,...,d_r}} = V^{Σ*}_{Δ_r} forment un syst. 1/2 simplicial de topos (de groupoïdes de multiplicités analytiques), dont la lim→ est équivalente canoniquement à V*_{Σ,X}.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It documents Grothendieck's intended method for the 'tower at infinity' of M_{g,n} (gluing inertia/stratum data into π_1 at infinity). This is relevant to the history of the Esquisse programme and to later work on profinite and anabelian aspects of boundary strata of moduli of curves.

deep.surprise_reason: The mathematics (gluing the punctured neighbourhood of an NCD from torus bundles over strata) is classical in substance. What is notable is the clean formulation as a 2-colimit of semi-simplicial topoi of analytic multiplicities, with Θ-admissible sets as sieves in an 'analytic 2-category' of strata, written for the M_{g,ν} programme. That is an unpublished detail, but not a surprising new result.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: likely '"catégories analytiques" envisagées au début de ces réflexions (v. p. 16 ff)' rather than 'groupoïdes de ces réflexions (v. Th ff)'.
Line 2: likely 'c'est une sous-2-catégorie pleine "stricte"' rather than 'faite une 2- -catégorie pleine'.
Parenthesis: '(stricte signifie que si un objet y est [dedans], les objets qui s'envoient dans y y sont — c'est donc un crible, en une terminologie vague), dont la donnée équivaut à celle de Σ ...)'.

The underlined title reads 'Th. de recollement (2ème version)', not 'Th. de van Kampen'; similarly the line above reads 'le "th. de recollement" prend ...'. This is consistent with the next page's 'la "th. de recollement"'.
'dans ce [?] généralités' probably 'dans sa généralité' or similar.
Final formula: V^*_{Σ,X} (the punctured tubular neighbourhood of Σ in X), with a struck-out X.
